title: Malicious code in @tops2/digital-assistant-ui (npm)
description: The npm package @tops2/digital-assistant-ui contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The presence of this package indicates a full system compromise, and all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
